description: Re-deploy skills WITHOUT changing any definitions. ⚠️ HEAVY OPERATION: regenerates MCP servers (Python code) for every skill, pushes each to A-Team Core, restarts connectors, and verifies tool discovery. Takes 30-120s depending on skill count. Use after connector restarts, Core hiccups, or stale state. For incremental changes, prefer ateam_patch (which updates + redeploys in one step).

skill_id.description: Optional: redeploy a single skill only. Omit to redeploy ALL skills in the solution.

name: ateam_redeploy
